title: 运行器独立预检
scope: 独立静态审查两个冻结源码文件；合成索引代数核验；不运行市场拟合。核心结论在主运行启动前通知根代理，正式书面记录在运行完成标记已可见时归档，不冒充额外事前注册。

checks.evidence: Input window tokens[t-63:t+1] includes only observations through origin t. Targets are p[t+h]-p[t], h=1,5,20. Predictions assume origin price p[t] has already been observed; horizons count observed target records.

If first test index is F, validation origins are F-100 ... F-21; selection training satisfies t+20 < F-100. Last training label is F-101, last validation label is F-1. Final refit includes only t+20 < F. Test origin and t+20 must both fall in the test year.

One fixed model per year; realized observations through each origin enter the 64-record window. No optimizer updates or validation-based reselection within that test year. All horizons share the same origins and last 20 target observations are not forecast origins.

For each carbon date d, backward as-of chooses last energy date <= d-14 calendar days. Missing source prices are excluded before alignment. Arithmetic differences are formed between aligned prices. These are public historical data files, not certified real-time vintages.

Channel RMS is fitted on tokens[1:validation_start], entirely before validation origins. It includes available pre-validation observations beyond the earliest training feature rows. Target second moments use only selected training targets. Both remain fixed during final refit.

With s=target RMS and v_h=training target second moment, (forecast/s - target/s)^2/(v_h/s^2) equals native squared error/v_h. Equal weight is assigned to H1/H5/H20; validation uses the same rule. Test primary instead divides each cell/horizon by its own RW test MSE, as declared.

Initial validation and every epoch validation call predict(model,...), which calls that same model's forward and horizon coordinates. No alternative filter, teacher output, or postprocessed proxy is used for choosing epochs.

Both learning rates use selection seed 17 on past validation. The minimum selected validation loss, tie-broken by lower learning rate, chooses the family configuration. Fresh model initializations with seeds 17/29/43 then refit all matured pretest labels for that selected epoch count.

Epoch 0 is a real scored initialization and saved state. It may defeat trained epochs. A final refit with selected_epoch=0 executes no training loop and records epochs_executed=0, zero gradient steps. Optimization parameter change is explicitly labeled before selection. GRU/LSTM epoch 0 equals RW because their readout is initialized to zero.

Full/readout use the same inputs, parameter count 169, learning-rate budget, and paired initial state. Readout gates final forecast amplitudes, whereas full gates historical innovation allocation. Constant is a nested 7-parameter control, price-only is 118 parameters; neither is capacity-matched to full.

GRU/LSTM and full-input allocation use 4 channels and 64 records. ridge_full uses 64 records; ridge_price and hgb_full use 20. All use past validation and matured-label final refits. Fair comparison holds for common information cutoff, but input history length, parameter count, and search dimensions are not globally identical.

Frozen protocol explicitly selects mean_seed_mse_over_rw as primary; scoring the average three-seed forecast is a separate ensemble secondary. Strong baseline family is selected per market/year from RW, drift, ridge_price, ridge_full, hgb_full, GRU, LSTM using past validation only.
All 2022/2023 cells are development evidence, not fresh confirmation. There is no universal 1% publication threshold. Neither static PASS nor completion demonstrates model utility or novelty.

residual_limitations: Static review does not replace independent reconstruction of observed targets and realized primary metrics from NPZ.
The execution-complete flag records whether hashes changed but does not itself throw on mismatch; downstream audit must reject a mismatch.
Selection on a single seed does not eliminate selection randomness; three refit seeds are algorithm randomness, not independent market observations.
The innovation model resets latent state at the start of every 64-record history. This finite-history convention is consistent but should be stated.
GRU/LSTM output 20 cumulative coordinates while only coordinates 1,5,20 enter loss; the other 17 output rows are unused in evaluation and included in raw parameter counts.
RMS uses the complete available pre-validation prefix, not only rows appearing as training inputs; this is not a validation/test lookahead claim.
No claim is made that observed latent components identify economic permanent or transitory shocks.
